why_this_file_exists: layout_contract_ceiling.json says of its own calibration: 'it must be replaced by a measured census the moment any other site's attributes are ingested.' The D-EU-23 G1 ingestion did exactly that. The original artefact is left byte-identical; this sidecar carries what is now measured.

corrected_claims.measured_now: Lyon emits 28 of the same 297 attribute-ready rows, and 28 of its 28 geometric clearers emit (1.00).
corrected_claims.cause: The same 297 buildings were re-measured with the same two imported predicates. Outcomes are identical row-for-row except the 10 rows that s1_layout_reachability_census.csv recorded as PARTITION_AUDIT_FAILED, all 10 of which now emit. generate_european_dwelling_layout rotates about the footprint centroid and audits against EUROPEAN_TOPOLOGY_TOLERANCE_FRACTION (a relative tolerance); the S1-era census predates both. The 18 was true when written and is false now.
corrected_claims.consequence_for_the_ruling: NONE. D-EU-23 was ruled G1 and stands. A dwelling-partitioned-only S3 of 96 is still not formable: 79 buildings emit across the whole ingested FR + ES corpus of 1,255 attribute-ready rows, and only 12 of them fall inside the ladder-selected 96.

corrected_claims.claim: calibration is the only one that exists, because Lyon is the only site where emission has been measured
corrected_claims.measured_now: Madrid's emission is now measured too, on 958 attribute-ready rows ingested under D-EU-23 G1.

still_projections_not_measurements.GB-LDN-STDUNSTANS: clears_geometric_half = 49 stands as a footprint-only predicate; emission is UNMEASURED because London is credential-blocked and no attribute was ingested.
still_projections_not_measurements.IT-BOL-GALVANI2: clears_geometric_half = 40 stands as a footprint-only predicate; emission is UNMEASURED and Italy contributes zero to S3 on typology regardless.

unchanged_by_this_correction: every clears_geometric_half count in the original file - those are footprint-only predicates over all footprints and were not affected
the conclusion that the binding ceiling is geometry rather than attributes: 1,183 of 1,194 Madrid footprints recover both attribute signals and 51 of them produce a dwelling layout
lesson: Third instance in this arc of a recorded blocker outliving the blockage. The S1 partition-audit refusal was real on 2026-08-25, was quoted as evidence in the D-EU-23 request on 2026-08-27, and was already false when quoted.
